text:
Pristine and final stone of unfounded

fortune, she has just died

with soul and all, October room and pregnant.

Of three months absent and ten of sweet.

How destiny,

mitred monodactyl, laughs.


How behind they evict assemblies

of opposites. How the numeral always appears

beneath the line of every avatar.


How whales charge doves a fee.

How these in turn leave the beak

cubed in a third wing.

How we saddle-bow ourselves, facing monotonous haunches.


It is towed ten months toward the ten,

toward another beyond.

Two remain at least still in swaddling clothes.

And the three months of absence.

And the nine of gestation.


There is not a single violence.

The patient rises,

and seated peacocks tranquil mixtures.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem X - Pristine and Final Stone of Unfounded
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's pregnancy arithmetic, mitred monodactyl, and invented verbal motions.
